jobs.title: Team Leader Quality Systems & Compliance (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own. As Team Leader Quality Systems & Compliance (m/f/d), you will lead our Document Control & Training team and serve as Global Business Process Owner for Document Control & Training across Straumann Group. In this role, you will ensure effective governance, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement of these critical quality processes. Combining people leadership with global process ownership, you will collaborate across functions and Group companies to maintain robust, harmonized, and future-ready quality systems. You will also act as a subject matter expert during third-party audits, support audit leadership as Front Office or Back Office Lead, contribute to Management Reviews and KPI reporting, and drive quality system improvement and digitalization initiatives. Your Role - Lead the Document Control & Training team, responsible for managing applicable QMS documents, regulatory documents, and standards at Straumann Group, Straumann Company, and Design Center Basel levels - Ensure effective document lifecycle management, controlled distribution, training assignment, and assessment of change adequacy in accordance with applicable procedures - Ensure QMS training is appropriately assigned, completed, and documented - Ensure effective implementation and maintenance of the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS) for QMS documentation - As Global Business Process Owner for Document Control & Training, ensure that eQMS tools and processes meet applicable regulatory requirements and evolve in response to emerging regulations and new product portfolio areas - Establish and monitor global KPIs for Document Control & Training - Facilitate regular exchanges among subject matter experts across Group companies to drive improvements, clarify change requests, assess impacts, and share best practices - Maintain the Group-level Document Control & Training SOP and promote harmonized processes across Group companies - Support the rollout of Document Control & Training processes to new entities and contribute to eQMS validation activities - Govern the Straumann Group-level document review process and ensure effective integration of Group-level documents into local Quality Management Systems - Act as a subject matter expert for your assigned quality process area during third-party audits, including audits by international health authorities - Serve as Back Office Lead or Front Office Lead, as assigned, supporting the overall Audit Lead in the effective execution of audits - Lead or contribute to small and medium-sized projects aimed at enhancing the Quality System, including continuous improvement and digitalization initiatives - Support the preparation and delivery of Management Reviews for Design Center Basel and Straumann Company, collaborating with Business Process Owners to compile the required KPIs Your 
• Profile - A university degree or equivalent qualification in quality, medicine, pharmacy, engineering, IT, or another relevant scientific discipline - At least five years of professional experience in Quality Management or Regulatory Affairs within the medical device or pharmaceutical industry - Experience leading a team - Expert knowledge of relevant medical device regulations and standards, particularly ISO 13485, Medical Device Regulation (EU) 2017/745 (MDR), FDA 21 CFR Part 820 Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), and applicable medical device regulations in MDSAP-participating jurisdictions - Experience working with document management systems in a regulated environment - Proven project management experience - Demonstrated ability to use digitalization such as powerBI, power automation, and generative AI to improve quality management processes - Fluent written and spoken English, additional languages are welcome What Makes You a Great Fit You take a proactive and solution-oriented approach and enjoy collaborating with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and locations. You can balance regulatory requirements with business and process needs and work effectively within an international matrix organization. You are comfortable navigating change, take ownership of your responsibilities, and look for practical ways to continuously improve how quality processes work. You are also curious about digital technologies and recognize opportunities to use automation and emerging tools to make processes more effective, efficient, and sustainable.

jobs.title: Intern RDI Academy Product Development
jobs.description: About the company Headquartered in Basel, Switzerland, Straumann is a global leader in implant and restorative dentistry and oral tissue regeneration. Having pioneered many of the most influential technologies and techniques in our field, we have a tradition of doing more to advance dental regeneration, restoration and replacement, as well as patient care. Straumann is renowned for providing profound clinical evidence to support the product portfolio and bring new solutions to the market. About the role You will join the Clinical Operation Department and work with the Global Clinical Evaluation and Evidence Team – a part of research, development, and innovation (RDI) at Institut Straumann AG. As a curious and scientifically oriented person, you are interested in gaining first insights into the collection, processing and analysis of data from relevant sources (literature, real-world data, clinical studies). You’ll be a part of an international team of scientists and specialists, mainly located at the global Headquarter in Basel. Duration 6 months. Your main responsibilities: - Conduct data analysis of Clinical Operation data input (e.g. literature, survey data, implant registry, clinical studies, etc.). - Support Clinical Operations data visualization (dashboards) and reporting. - Leverage AI-based technology to streamline literature search and data extraction. - Support of clinical data management activities across Clinical Operations (data documentation, standardization and consumption) Who are we looking for? - Master's degree, preferably in Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, or Life Sciences. - Experience with data analysis tools (e.g. R, Python, SAS, or equivalent). - Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, R Shiny). - Knowledgeable of relevant programming languages (e.g. Python, SQL) - Knowledgeable of extract-transform-load (ETL) pipelines, preferentially using Amazon Web Services tools, and of Snowflake for data consumption. - Proactive individual with a structured work approach and the ability of achieving results pragmatically. - Demonstrates a "Player-Learner" attitude: open communication, adaptable to change, solution-oriented, learns through practical experience, and welcomes feedback. - Exhibits a high level of integrity, commitment, and ethical conduct. - Proficient in written and verbal communication in English. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability. Employment Type: Intern Alternative Locations: Switzerland : Basel Travel Percentage: 0% Requisition ID: 22282

descriptionByLocale.it: Con sede a Basilea, in Svizzera, Straumann è leader globale nel settore dell'odontoiatria implantare e della rigenerazione del tessuto orale. Essendo pionieri di molte delle tecnologie e tecniche più influenti nel nostro campo, abbiamo una tradizione di fare di più per promuovere la rigenerazione dentale, il restauro e la sostituzione, così come la cura del paziente. Straumann è rinomata per fornire prove cliniche profonde per supportare il portafoglio prodotti e portare nuove soluzioni al mercato. Riguardo al ruolo che si unirà al Dipartimento di Operazione Clinica e lavorerà con il Global Clinical Evaluation and Evidence Team – una parte di ricerca, sviluppo e innovazione (RDI) presso l'Institut Straumann AG. In quanto persona curiosa e scientificamente orientata, siete interessati ad acquisire le prime informazioni sulla raccolta, elaborazione e analisi dei dati da fonti rilevanti (letteratura, dati reali, studi clinici). Sarete parte di un team internazionale di scienziati e specialisti, situato principalmente presso la sede globale di Basilea. Durata 6 mesi. Le tue principali responsabilità: - Condurre l'analisi dei dati dell'inserimento dei dati di Operazione Clinica (ad esempio letteratura, dati di indagine, registro impianti, studi clinici, ecc.). - Supporta la visualizzazione dei dati delle Operazioni Cliniche (dashboard) e la segnalazione. - Leverage tecnologia basata su AI per semplificare la ricerca della letteratura e l'estrazione dei dati. - Supporto delle attività di gestione dei dati clinici nelle operazioni cliniche (documentazione dei dati, standardizzazione e consumo) Chi stiamo cercando? - Laurea magistrale, preferibilmente in Scienze dei dati, Ingegneria biomedica, o Scienze della vita. - Esperienza con strumenti di analisi dei dati (ad esempio R, Python, SAS o equivalente). - Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati (ad esempio Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, R Shiny). - Conoscenza dei linguaggi di programmazione rilevanti (ad esempio Python, SQL) - Conoscenza delle tubazioni (ETL), preferenziale utilizzando gli strumenti Amazon Web Services e Snowflake per il consumo di dati. - individuo proattivo con un approccio di lavoro strutturato e la capacità di ottenere risultati pragmaticamente. - Dimostra un atteggiamento "Player-Learner": comunicazione aperta, adattabile al cambiamento, orientata alla soluzione, impara attraverso l'esperienza pratica e accoglie il feedback. - Mostra un alto livello di integrità, impegno e condotta etica. - Proficiente nella comunicazione scritta e verbale in inglese. Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, o disabilità. Tipo di occupazione: Intern Alternative Località: Svizzera: Basel Percentuale di viaggio: 0% Requisition ID: 22282

Über das Unternehmen Straumann mit Hauptsitz in Basel, Schweiz, ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Implantat- und Restorationszahnmedizin und oraler Geweberegeneration. Mit vielen der einflussreichsten Technologien und Techniken in unserem Bereich haben wir eine Tradition, mehr für die Zahnregeneration, die Wiederherstellung und den Ersatz von Zahnersatz sowie die Patientenversorgung zu tun. Straumann ist bekannt für seine fundierten klinischen Nachweise, um das Produktportfolio zu unterstützen und neue Lösungen auf den Markt zu bringen.

Über die Rolle Sie werden der Abteilung Klinische Operation beiwohnen und arbeiten mit dem Global Clinical Evaluation and Evidence Team – einem Teil der Forschung, Entwicklung und Innovation (RDI) am Institut Straumann AG. Als neugierige und wissenschaftlich ausgerichtete Person sind Sie daran interessiert, erste Einblicke in die Sammlung, Verarbeitung und Analyse von Daten aus relevanten Quellen (Litere, Real-World-Daten, klinische Studien) zu gewinnen. Sie werden Teil eines internationalen Teams von Wissenschaftlern und Spezialisten sein, die sich vor allem am globalen Hauptsitz in Basel befinden. Dauer: 6 Monate.

Ihre Hauptaufgaben: - Durchführung der Datenanalyse der Dateneingabe in den klinischen Betrieb (z.B. Literatur, Umfragedaten, Implantatregister, klinische Studien, etc.). - Unterstützung der Datenvisualisierung (Dashboards) und Berichterstattung. - Leverage KI-basierte Technologie zur Optimierung der Literaturrecherche und Datenextraktion. - Unterstützung der klinischen Datenmanagementaktivitäten in den klinischen Betrieb (Datendokumentation, Standardisierung und Verbrauch) Wen suchen wir? - Masterstudium, vorzugsweise in Data Science, Biomedical Engineering oder Life Sciences.

- Erfahrung mit Datenanalysetools (z.B. R, Python, SAS oder Äquivalent). - Erfahrung mit Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. Power BI, Tableau, Spotfire, R Shiny). - Kenntnis der relevanten Programmiersprachen (z.B. Python, SQL) - Kenntnis der extract-transform-load (ETL) Pipelines, bevorzugt mit Amazon Web Services Tools, und von Snowflake für den Datenverbrauch. - Proaktive Einzelperson mit einem strukturierten Arbeitskonzept und der Fähigkeit, pragmatisch Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

- Demonstration einer "Player-Learner" Haltung: offene Kommunikation, anpassungsfähig an Veränderungen, Lösungsorientiert, lernt durch praktische Erfahrung, und begrüßt Feedback. - Zeigt ein hohes Maß an Integrität, Engagement und ethischen Verhalten. - Proficient in schriftlicher und verbaler Kommunikation in Englisch. Alle qualifizierten Bewerber erhalten Rücksicht auf Beschäftigung ohne Rücksicht auf Rasse, Farbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuelle Ausrichtung, Geschlechtsidentität, nationale Herkunft, oder Behinderung. descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos de l'entreprise Basée à Bâle, en Suisse, Straumann est un leader mondial en implants, en dentisterie réparatrice et en régénération des tissus buccaux. Ayant été les pionniers de nombreuses technologies et techniques les plus influentes dans notre domaine, nous avons la tradition de faire davantage pour faire progresser la régénération dentaire, la restauration et le remplacement, ainsi que les soins aux patients. Straumann est réputée pour avoir fourni des preuves cliniques profondes pour soutenir le portefeuille de produits et apporter de nouvelles solutions au marché. À propos du rôle Vous rejoindrez le Département des opérations cliniques et travaillerez avec l'équipe mondiale d'évaluation clinique et de preuve – une partie de la recherche, du développement et de l'innovation (RDI) à l'Institut Straumann AG. jobs.description:
Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own. The global dental industry is evolving rapidly. As dental practices increasingly join larger networks and Dental Service Organizations (DSOs), new opportunities are emerging to transform how oral healthcare is delivered. At Straumann Group, our Global Enterprise Solutions team builds long-term strategic partnerships with leading DSOs worldwide, bringing together our comprehensive portfolio of dental solutions, technologies, and services to help our partners grow and deliver better patient outcomes. The Global Head of DSO Education Services plays a pivotal role in defining and executing a cohesive global educational service strategy that’s robust, standardized, repeatable and scalable for our DSO customer target group. This individual will create and execute a clinical excellence strategy to establish Straumann Group as the partner of choice for clinical excellence in the field of Surgical Implantology, Restorative, Orthodontics and Digital Dentistry. Your role Set the strategy and value proposition - Define and champion the Enterprise Education vision, value proposition and global strategy, addressing the talent and capability challenges facing DSOs - Develop short- and long-term strategies to scale and commercialise education across clinical, business and leadership domains. - Translate DSO needs into differentiated propositions for C-suite leaders, providers, practice teams and platform teams. Build the education architecture and customer offer - Create learning pathways that connect clinical excellence with business performance, leadership capability and effective team practice. - Develop customer segmentation and tiering strategies that make the offer relevant to different DSO needs and maturity levels. - Design scalable education concepts that combine in-person, digital and blended formats, working with the Education Architecture & Design team to ensure effective and efficient delivery. - Ensure the offer reflects the breadth of the Straumann Group portfolio, including digital solutions and new launches. Create a scalable delivery and commercial model - Establish frameworks, processes and governance needed to design, contract, deliver and continuously improve education programmes for DSO customers. - Develop scalable delivery models especially focussed on in person/live patient training - Define how LMS platforms and other learning technologies can improve the customer experience and support future integration with top-tier customers. - Partner with regional and country organisations across NAM, EMEA and APAC to implement the global strategy while adapting delivery to local needs. Shape the offer with customers and internal partners - Build strong relationships with DSO C-suite stakeholders, including Chief Medical Officers and CCOs across top- and mid-tier customers, to understand needs and shape relevant solutions. - Partner with the Consulting team to connect business education pathways with DSO network assessments and broader transformation priorities. - Work closely with Business Units and ITI to represent Enterprise needs and adapt relevant content for DSO environments. - Collaborate across Enterprise Solutions to keep education content current, portfolio-complete and aligned with customer priorities. Enable the organisation to deliver - Define the capabilities and training requirements for internal Clinical Education Specialists (CES), including course content, training materials and web-based learning. - Equip regional and country teams to deliver the proposition consistently through clear frameworks, tools, training and implementation guidance. - Act as an internal advocate for Enterprise Education, building awareness and alignment across Straumann Group functions and markets. - Develop and manage Enterprise Key Opinion Leader relationships in support of the global education strategy. Measure impact and improve performance - Establish education KPIs and reporting at global, regional, customer and programme levels. - Track adoption, learner experience and capability outcomes, and use evidence to refine the offer and demonstrate value to customers and the business. 
• Your profile 
• What you bring - Bachelor’s degree in education, business, healthcare or a related field, or equivalent experience. - 7+ years of experience in enterprise education, services, business development or programme management. - Proven ability to design and scale capability programmes or lead complex programmes from strategy through delivery. - Understanding of clinical education and how it connects to business, leadership and workforce needs. - Experience leading global, cross-functional initiatives and engaging senior stakeholders. Nice to haves Experience working in clinical processes in implantology, restorative and Orthodontics departments. This role operates our hybrid working model 60% presence in office, 40% flexible working. Regular travel (30- 40%) is required. What makes you a great fit? You can combine strategic thinking with a focus on execution and are conformable navigating changing priorities in complex environments with an entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable building trusted relationships across cross-functional business groups. You are collaborative and take ownership of outcomes and use customer insights to improve solutions.

A Straumann Group, il nostro team di Global Enterprise Solutions costruisce partnership strategiche a lungo termine con i principali DSO in tutto il mondo, mettendo insieme il nostro portafoglio completo di soluzioni dentali, tecnologie e servizi per aiutare i nostri partner a crescere e a fornire risultati migliori ai pazienti. Il Global Head of DSO Education Services svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione e nell’esecuzione di una strategia di servizio educativo globale coerente, robusta, standardizzata, ripetibile e scalabile per il nostro gruppo target di clienti DSO. Questo individuo creerà ed eseguirà una strategia di eccellenza clinica per stabilire il Gruppo Straumann come partner di scelta per l'eccellenza clinica nel campo dell'Implantologia Chirurgica, Restorativa, Ortodontica e Digital Dentistry. Impostare la strategia e la proposizione del valore - Definire e sostenere la visione Enterprise Education, la proposizione del valore e la strategia globale, affrontando le sfide di talento e capacità che affrontano le DSO - Sviluppare strategie a breve e a lungo termine per scalare e commercializzare l'istruzione in ambiti clinici, aziendali e di leadership. - Traduci DSO ha bisogno di proposte differenziate per leader C-suite, fornitori, team di pratica e team di piattaforma. Costruire l'architettura dell'istruzione e l'offerta dei clienti - Creare percorsi di apprendimento che collegano l'eccellenza clinica con le prestazioni aziendali, la capacità di leadership e la pratica del team efficace. - Sviluppare strategie di segmentazione e tiering dei clienti che rendono l'offerta rilevante alle diverse esigenze e livelli di maturità del DSO. - Design concetti di formazione scalabile che combinano formati in-persona, digitale e misto, lavorando con il team di Education Architecture & Design per garantire una consegna efficace ed efficiente. - Assicurarsi che l'offerta rifletta l'ampiezza del portafoglio di Straumann Group, comprese le soluzioni digitali e i nuovi lancio. Creare un modello di consegna scalabile e commerciale - Stabilire quadri, processi e governance necessari per progettare, contrarre, fornire e migliorare continuamente i programmi di istruzione per i clienti DSO. - Sviluppare modelli di consegna scalabili particolarmente focalizzati sulla formazione dei pazienti di persona/live - Definire come piattaforme LMS e altre tecnologie di apprendimento possono migliorare l'esperienza del cliente e supportare l'integrazione futura con i clienti di alto livello. - Collaborare con organizzazioni regionali e nazionali in NAM, EMEA e APAC per implementare la strategia globale, adattando la consegna alle esigenze locali. Formare l'offerta con clienti e partner interni - Costruire relazioni forti con gli stakeholder DSO C-suite, tra cui Chief Medical Officers e CCOs attraverso i clienti di alto e medio livello, per comprendere le esigenze e modellare le soluzioni pertinenti. - Collaborare con il team Consulting per collegare percorsi di formazione aziendale con valutazioni della rete DSO e priorità di trasformazione più ampie. - Lavorare a stretto contatto con Business Units e ITI per rappresentare le esigenze di Enterprise e adattare i contenuti rilevanti per gli ambienti DSO. - Collabora con Enterprise Solutions per mantenere i contenuti educativi attuali, conformi al portafoglio e allineati con le priorità del cliente. Abilitare l'organizzazione a fornire - Definire le capacità e i requisiti di formazione per gli specialisti dell'istruzione clinica interna (CES), compresi i contenuti dei corsi, i materiali di formazione e l'apprendimento web-based. - Equipaggiate i team regionali e nazionali per fornire la proposta in modo coerente attraverso chiare strutture, strumenti, formazione e guida all'implementazione. - Agire come sostenitore interno per l'istruzione aziendale, la sensibilizzazione e l'allineamento attraverso le funzioni e i mercati del Gruppo Straumann. - Sviluppare e gestire le relazioni Enterprise Key Opinion Leader a sostegno della strategia globale dell'istruzione. Misurare l'impatto e migliorare le prestazioni - Stabilire i KPI di istruzione e la reportistica a livello globale, regionale, cliente e programma. - Traccia l'adozione, l'esperienza degli studenti e i risultati delle capacità, e usa prove per affinare l'offerta e dimostrare valore ai clienti e al business.
• Il tuo profilo
• Che cosa si porta - Corso di laurea in istruzione, business, assistenza sanitaria o un campo correlato, o esperienza equivalente. - 7+ anni di esperienza nell'istruzione aziendale, nei servizi, nello sviluppo aziendale o nella gestione dei programmi. - Prove capacità di progettare e scalare programmi di capacità o condurre programmi complessi dalla strategia attraverso la consegna. - Comprensione dell'educazione clinica e come si collega alle esigenze di business, leadership e forza lavoro. - Esperienza leader di iniziative globali, interfunzionali e coinvolgenti stakeholder senior. È bello avere esperienza di lavoro nei processi clinici nei reparti di implantologia, restauro e ortodonzia. Questo ruolo gestisce il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido 60% presenza in ufficio, 40% lavoro flessibile. È richiesto un viaggio regolare (30- 40%). Che cosa ti rende una grande misura? È possibile combinare il pensiero strategico con un focus sull'esecuzione e sono conformi alla navigazione delle priorità mutevoli in ambienti complessi con una mentalità imprenditoriale. Siete comodi costruire relazioni di fiducia attraverso gruppi di affari interfunzionali. Sei collaborativo e prendi la proprietà dei risultati e usa le informazioni dei clienti per migliorare le soluzioni.

Chez Straumann Group, nous sommes sur un parcours passionnant de croissance, d'innovation et d'impact, animé par notre mission d'améliorer la santé buccodentaire et de transformer des millions de vies dans le monde entier. Unis par le but, nous apportons nos meilleurs nous-mêmes au travail chaque jour, en adoptant une culture de haute performance, joueur-learner qui inspire la collaboration, la curiosité et l'ambition. Ici, vous aurez l'occasion de prendre en main votre propre carrière, d'exploiter vos compétences, votre passion et votre enthousiasme pour apprendre à croître et à progresser continuellement. Ensemble, nous ne formons pas seulement des sourires plus brillants, nous débloquons le potentiel des gens partout, y compris le nôtre. L'industrie dentaire mondiale évolue rapidement. À mesure que les pratiques dentaires rejoignent de plus en plus les grands réseaux et les organismes de services dentaires, de nouvelles possibilités se présentent pour transformer la façon dont les soins buccodentaires sont dispensés. Cette personne créera et exécutera une stratégie d'excellence clinique pour établir le groupe Straumann comme partenaire de choix pour l'excellence clinique dans le domaine de l'implantologie chirurgicale, de la restauration, de l'orthodontie et de la dentisterie numérique. Créer un modèle de prestation évolutive et commercial - Établir les cadres, les processus et la gouvernance nécessaires à la conception, à la passation de marchés, à la prestation et à l'amélioration continue des programmes d'éducation à l'intention des clients des OSM. - Mettre au point des modèles de prestation évolutives, particulièrement axés sur la formation des patients en personne et en vie - Définir comment les plates-formes LMS et d'autres technologies d'apprentissage peuvent améliorer l'expérience client et soutenir l'intégration future avec les clients de haut niveau. - Établir un partenariat avec les organisations régionales et nationales du Mouvement des pays non alignés, de l ' EMEA et de l ' APAC pour mettre en œuvre la stratégie mondiale tout en adaptant les prestations aux besoins locaux. Vous êtes en collaboration et vous appropriez les résultats et utilisez les connaissances des clients pour améliorer les solutions.
